RiskName: Exposed Azure Client ID or Tenant ID

MariaDB server is a community developed fork of MySQL server. From versions 10.6.1 to before 10.6.26, 10.11.1 to before 10.11.17, 11.4.1 to before 11.4.11, 11.8.1 to before 11.8.7, and 12.3.1, mbstream did not check for /../ in the path when unpacking the archive. A proper backup can never contain such paths, but a specially crafted archive could have caused mbstream to create files outside of the target-dir path. This issue has been patched in versions 10.6.26, 10.11.17, 11.4.11, 11.8.7, and 12.3.2.

Description: This web service had an HSTS header that did not specify includeSubDomains.
Remediations:
["Add the includeSubDomains directive while following [a best practices guide](https://www.upguard.com/blog/hsts),
also slowly incrementing max-age while ensuring the web service and subdomains do not break due to increased
restrictions being imposed on clients' browsers.

The goal should be to have a header value similar to this, with a year or longer max-age in seconds:
  Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload
"]
